text:
maria: Following up on the postmortem action items focused on GPU capacity and autoscaling. Please claim an item and drop an ETA by EOD so I can add to the tracker.

devon: I can own scheduler tuning (bin-packing heuristics, preemption thresholds, max-pods-per-gpu). Planning a small canary with traffic shaping. ETA: 2026-04-02.

aj: I will take headroom policy and autoscaler config (stabilization windows, scale rate). Need tail-latency traces to pick safe thresholds. ETA: proposal 2026-03-30.

kim: Cloud quota ticket opened (CS-2026-5512). Support asked for 1hr peak profile; requested current fleet + 40% as provisional. Reply expected in 48h. If quota denied, fallback: cross-region spill or smaller model variants.

oliver: I'll draft the oncall playbook for GPU pressure (checks, comms, escalation). First draft 2026-03-28.

sre-bot: Incident summary: GPU pool saturation on 2026-03-18 14:03 PDT. Autoscaler slow due to long node provisioning and conservative scaleUp. Logs: /infra/logs/2026-03-18/gpu-scale-events.log

devex: I'll add telemetry: per-model tokens/sec, per-pod GPU mem util, autoscaler decision traces. Dashboards + alerts in a PR. ETA: 2026-03-31.

aj: Draft autoscaler snippet (will iterate):
```
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
spec:
  behavior:
    scaleUp:
      stabilizationWindowSeconds: 20
      policies:
        - type: Percent
          value: 250
          periodSeconds: 60
    scaleDown:
      stabilizationWindowSeconds: 240
      policies:
        - type: Percent
          value: 50
          periodSeconds: 60
```
Reserve 20% GPUs for bursty chat during canary. Tune after 2w.

maria: Pattern note: spikes coincide with nightly batch finisher + partner jobs around 14:00 PDT. Options: 1) reschedule batch to off-peak, 2) keep hot pool + fast scale-up.

kim: Cloud asked for burst numbers (concurrent pods, ramp time). @devon @aj please share estimates. I put 15min ramp in the ticket for now.

devon: Will run a short load profile to estimate 1hr peak GPU usage and post by 2026-03-26 noon.

oliver: Playbook checklist (draft):
- Check capacity dashboard + top consumers
- If avg GPU util > 80% for 10m -> escalate and increase reserved headroom
- If autoscaler fails to add nodes -> open quota escalation and route non-critical traffic to smaller model variants
- If node provisioning latency > 5m -> consider warm pool + pre-provision policy
I'll add commands and links.

maria: I'll consolidate these into the postmortem action-tracker and set weekly checkpoints (Wednesdays) until closed. If owners need more time, ping me. :white_check_mark:

aj: Confirmed ETA: 2026-03-30 for headroom policy PR.

devon: Confirmed ETA: 2026-04-02 for scheduler canary and results.

kim: Updating CS-2026-5512 in this thread; next cloud update expected 2026-03-24.

devex: Instrumentation PR ETA: 2026-03-31, includes alerts for hot shards and autoscaler failures.

maria: Thanks everyone. I will add tracker rows and assign. Weekly reminder set for Weds x6. Report slips here. :thumbsup:
